goal.text: Answer every question about the corpus. The corpus is a FILE in the run dir (see the observation's corpus_path): read it with your own offline tools; it is not in the observation. BANK_FACT {text, span} commits a corpus-grounded fact (span must be a verbatim substring, checked in code). SUBMIT {answer, spans} answers the current question, citing verbatim spans; it is additionally coverage-gated by the v1 census (>=1 verified BANK_FACT for the current question). Answers are recorded SEALED and scored only at finalize; during the run the referee grades evidence integrity (span verbatim-presence and coverage), never correctness. text/span/answer are base64-encoded UTF-8; spans is base64 of a JSON array of strings (ASSAY tokens are whitespace-split). WIN = all questions submitted with the census clean.

mode_note: OOLONG query-framed corpus pack (M1). Sized for small packs (<=~5 questions). Actuators: BANK_FACT, SUBMIT. See bench/oolong/PROTOCOL.md.

actions.name: BANK_FACT
actions.description: commit a fact citing a corpus span; text and span are base64-encoded UTF-8. The span is verified as a verbatim substring of the corpus in code; a span not present is refused and the attempt is journaled.

actions.name: SUBMIT
actions.description: submit the answer to the current question; answer is base64-encoded UTF-8 and spans is base64 of a JSON array of verbatim corpus strings. Span-gated and coverage-gated; on acceptance the answer is sealed and scored only at finalize.
